title: Spring Boot Basics and REST Controllers
description: What Spring Boot adds to Spring, generating and reading a Boot project, dependency injection and bean scopes, how auto-configuration works, and REST controllers with path, query and body parameters, ResponseEntity status codes and an OpenAPI description explored in Swagger UI.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S1-S2.
Module grouping is a second-mate grouping decision (closing source-gap-spring-boot-modules), not syllabus: modules follow calendar day sequence, S1-S2 here.
Fast mapping: FT1 rows 0-5 and FT2 rows 1-3 map to these topics; '(skim)' suffixes are Fast emphasis metadata, not separate pages.

Module coding lab (captain-approved addition beyond the S1-S2 Concept-day overlay): required Standard real-toolchain practice at coding-lab/ (trackRequirement standard required, fast not-required), mvn -q -o test, Spring Boot 4.1.2, no database, no container engine; Fast skips coding labs.

Standard placement: the required module coding lab runs on S2 in the frozen Concept-day 40-minute 'Faded, then fresh problem' coding-lab block (curriculum/snapshot/pep-calendar.json dayTypes.Concept), after the four S2 pages and the practice mastery check. Authoring estimate, not piloted, with no slack: no S2 topic links a video, so the four pages (58 minutes) fill Reading, Short video, Worked example and Short exercises (55) and 3 minutes of that block, the check takes up to 15 and the lab's 22 task minutes fill the remaining 22, so S2 stays at 120 minutes; the one-time online setup (mvn -q dependency:go-offline, about 8 minutes) is done before the block, as in html-css-js/dom-tooling-and-async. The lab sits outside the calendar's lab overlay, because S2 is a Concept day with requiredLab false, but inside a Concept-day block whose calendar format is coding lab. This supersedes the intake's no-lab statement for spring-boot-basics (authoring/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, section Lab plan), which is left for a course-level follow-up branch.

Partial objective coverage in the module coding lab (recorded, no lab change): for path-query-and-body-parameters#o1 it binds a path variable, an optional query parameter and a JSON body but no required query parameter, which the page and the practice mastery check (path-query-and-body-parameters#o2) cover; for dependency-injection-replacing-manual-wiring#o1 it replaces one manual new in the controller with constructor injection of a configured bean, and wiring across controller, service and repository layers is taught by constructor-injection-across-layers and applied in the porting-and-configuration module lab on S3-S4; for response-codes-with-responseentity#o1 it practices 200, 201 with Location and 404 but not 204, which the page's editor activity (a DELETE handler returning noContent), the mastery-check feedback and the graded course final cover.

Practice mastery check authored at assessments/spring-boot-basics-mastery-check/ (blueprint plus learner-visible practice.gift, ungraded, 15 minutes at most); the graded course final is the separate course-level blueprint spring-boot/assessments/spring-boot-final-assessment.
